answer: Two ledgers sit on the counting-house desk, and neither may be altered without the other showing it. Proof of cartographer chart via soundings ledger keeps the pair: a chart the cartographer inks only after he sounds a depth he actually plumbed. The spiral is the first ledger, written when the goods came in; the saffron is the second, written when they went out. To cook the books a cheat must rewrite 31 entries in both ledgers on the same night, and the kernel still remembers the hand that wrote the first line.
